label: General psychopathology (p)
description: Superordinate general factor capturing shared variance across all spectra
primary_source: Kotov et al. (2017); Kotov et al. (2021)

label: Emotional dysfunction superspectrum
description: Broad superspectrum spanning internalizing and somatoform spectra

label: Psychosis superspectrum
description: Broad superspectrum spanning thought disorder and detachment spectra

label: Externalizing superspectrum
description: Broad superspectrum spanning disinhibited and antagonistic externalizing
primary_source: Krueger et al. (2021); Kotov et al. (2017)

label: Internalizing
description: Spectrum of distress, fear, eating pathology, and related conditions

label: Somatoform
description: Spectrum of bodily distress, conversion, health anxiety (provisional placement)
primary_source: Watson et al. (2022); Sellbom et al. (2021)

label: Thought disorder
description: Spectrum of reality distortion, disorganization, mania-related psychoticism

label: Detachment
description: Spectrum of social withdrawal, anhedonia, restricted affect
primary_source: Kotov et al. (2020); Zimmermann et al. (2021)

label: Disinhibited externalizing
description: Spectrum of impulsivity, substance use, irresponsibility
primary_source: Kotov et al. (2017); Mullins-Sweatt et al. (2019)

label: Antagonistic externalizing
description: Spectrum of aggression, callousness, manipulativeness, narcissism

label: Neurodevelopmental (provisional)
description: Provisional spectrum incl. ADHD-inattention, autism-related features, learning problems
primary_source: Kotov et al. (2021); Stevanovic et al. (2024)

label: Distress subfactor
primary_source: Kotov et al. (2017); Watson et al. (2022)

label: Fear subfactor
description: Panic, agoraphobia, specific phobia, social anxiety, OCD
primary_source: Kotov et al. (2017); Watson et al. (2022)

label: Eating pathology subfactor
description: Binge eating, restricting, purging, body dissatisfaction
primary_source: Forbush et al. (2018); Watson et al. (2022)

label: Sexual problems subfactor
description: Low desire, arousal and orgasmic difficulties (provisional)

label: Mania subfactor
description: Activation, grandiosity, decreased need for sleep; bridges internalizing and thought disorder
primary_source: Kotov et al. (2020); Watson et al. (2022)

label: Substance abuse subfactor
description: Alcohol, cannabis, stimulant and other substance-related problems
primary_source: Kotov et al. (2017); Krueger et al. (2021)

label: Antisocial behavior subfactor
description: Rule-breaking, conduct problems, irresponsibility (loads on both externalizing spectra)
